description: Flat metadata schema for individual freshwater lake water samples collected across depths, locations, and seasons for environmental measurements and metagenomic sequencing.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample record.

project_id.descr: Study or project identifier linking related samples.

lake_name.descr: Name of the freshwater lake where the sample was collected.

site_name.descr: Named sampling station or location within the lake.

sample_elevation_m.descr: Sampling site elevation above sea level in meters, if applicable.

sampling_season.descr: Season of collection; recommended values: spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter.

sampling_time_local.descr: Local time of collection, if available (HH:MM:SS).

water_body_type.descr: Type of water body; expected value here is freshwater lake.

sampling_depth_m.descr: Depth below water surface where the sample was collected, in meters.

depth_interval_m.descr: Vertical thickness of the sampled layer in meters, if integrated over a depth range.

depth_reference.descr: Reference point for depth measurement; e.g., water surface, lake bottom.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature at the sampling depth, in degrees Celsius.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration at sampling depth, in milligrams per liter.

conductivity_uS_cm.descr: Water conductivity at sampling depth, in microsiemens per centimeter.

pH.descr: Water pH measured in situ or from the collected sample.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Turbidity of the water sample, in nephelometric turbidity units.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration, in micrograms per liter, if measured.

nitrate_mg_l.descr: Nitrate concentration, typically reported as mg/L NO3- or as specified in the assay description.

nitrite_mg_l.descr: Nitrite concentration, typically reported as mg/L NO2- or as specified in the assay description.

ammonium_mg_l.descr: Ammonium concentration, typically reported as mg/L NH4+ or as specified in the assay description.

phosphate_mg_l.descr: Orthophosphate or phosphate concentration, typically reported as mg/L PO4^3- or as specified in the assay description.

total_nitrogen_mg_l.descr: Total nitrogen concentration in milligrams per liter, if measured.

total_phosphorus_mg_l.descr: Total phosphorus concentration in milligrams per liter, if measured.

dissolved_organic_carbon_mg_l.descr: Dissolved organic carbon concentration in milligrams per liter, if measured.

sample_volume_l.descr: Total volume of water collected for this sample, in liters.

pre_filtration_used.descr: Whether a pre-filtration step was applied before final filtration or extraction.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Pore size of the filter used for biomass capture, in micrometers.

filter_material.descr: Filter membrane material; e.g., polyethersulfone, cellulose nitrate, GF/F.

filtered_volume_l.descr: Volume of water filtered for nucleic acid extraction, in liters.

filtration_device.descr: Filtration apparatus or device used, if applicable.

sample_preservation_method.descr: Method used to preserve the sample prior to extraction; e.g., freezing, RNAlater, ethanol.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature before nucleic acid extraction, in degrees Celsius.

storage_duration_h.descr: Duration between collection and extraction or processing, in hours.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted; expected value here is DNA for metagenomics, or DNA/RNA if both were extracted.

extraction_method.descr: Nucleic acid extraction protocol or kit used.

extraction_yield_ng_ul.descr: Measured nucleic acid concentration after extraction, in ng/µL.

extraction_quality_ratio.descr: Purity metric such as A260/A280 or equivalent.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library construction protocol or kit used before sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, HiSeq, NextSeq.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing approach; e.g., shotgun metagenomics, paired-end, long-read.

read_layout.descr: Read configuration; e.g., single-end or paired-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Length of sequencing reads in base pairs.

insert_size_bp.descr: Expected library insert size in base pairs, if applicable.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for this sample.

raw_base_count_bp.descr: Total number of raw bases generated for this sample, in base pairs.

quality_filtering_method.descr: Method used for read trimming or quality filtering.

host_contamination_removed.descr: Whether contaminant removal or decontamination was performed.

assembly_performed.descr: Whether metagenomic assembly was performed for this sample.

assembly_method.descr: Assembler or assembly workflow used, if assembly was performed.

contig_n50_bp.descr: Assembly N50 in base pairs, if an assembly was generated.

taxonomic_profiling_method.descr: Method or tool used to infer taxonomic composition; e.g., Kraken2, MetaPhlAn.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method or tool used for functional annotation; e.g., KEGG, eggNOG, HUMAnN.

metagenome_accession.descr: Accession number or identifier for the raw metagenomic sequence data in a public repository.

data_repository.descr: Repository hosting the sequence data; e.g., NCBI SRA, ENA, DDBJ.

biosample_accession.descr: BioSample or equivalent sample accession identifier.

environmental_context.descr: Free-text or controlled term describing the ecological context; e.g., oligotrophic lake, eutrophic lake, pelagic zone, littoral zone.

study_focus.descr: Primary research objective for this sample; e.g., microbial community structure, functional potential, seasonal dynamics.
